items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: Not for the foundational tracks. We'll place you based on where you actually are, not where you think you should be.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the track — you'll see exact numbers before you commit to anything. Register to get a personalized recommendation and pricing.

items.question: How is this different from a generic online course?
items.answer: Every track is project-first — you build real things and get real feedback, not just watch videos and take quizzes.

items.question: How much time will this take?
items.answer: Most tracks run 4-6 weeks at a few hours a week. You control the pace within that window.
